definitions.explanation: Lacking defense or protection against attack, danger, or harm.
Showing no caution or wariness, often in a personal or emotional sense. Can describe someone who is innocently open or naive.

examples.japanese: {無防備|むぼうび}な⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧だ。
{無防備|むぼうび}な⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国際法|こくさいほう}⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧だ。
examples.english: Attacking an undefended city violates international law.

examples.japanese: ⟦サイバー→サイバー：28281_saibaa⟧⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧{無防備|むぼうび}な⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many companies are unprotected against cyberattacks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無防備|むぼうび}な⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧。
⟦{寝顔|ねがお}→寝顔：29325_negao⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無防備|むぼうび}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{可愛|かわい}い。
examples.english: Their sleeping face is unguarded and cute.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{疑|うたが}わない→疑う：01889_utagau⟧{無防備|むぼうび}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧だまされる。
examples.english: He has an unguarded personality that doesn't suspect others, so he often gets deceived.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) + ⟦{防備|ぼうび}→防備：24094_boubi⟧ (defense, guard). Can describe physical defenselessness (a city without military protection) or personal openness (an unguarded expression). The figurative sense is common in everyday conversation and manga/anime descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無防備|むぼうび}な⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: an unguarded appearance
- {無防備|むぼうび}な⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧: an undefended city (legal/military term)
- {無防備|むぼうび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧さらす: to leave exposed without protection

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{油断|ゆだん}→油断：04085_yudan⟧: carelessness; letting one's guard down — focuses on a momentary lapse in vigilance
- ⟦{丸腰|まるごし}→丸腰：27230_marugoshi⟧: unarmed — specifically without weapons
- ⟦{無力|むりょく}→無力：13419_muryoku⟧: powerless — lacking strength or ability rather than defense
